svg.title: World religious composition, 2020-2100
svg.text: Share of world population. Reference scenario (stabilising): mean of 40 runs, the 5-95% spread of the runs, and the 90% predictive interval. Grey line: the range of all 8 scenario means.
The run spread is parameter uncertainty. The predictive interval adds the forecast errors the model made on 1970-2010 (resampled by decade, scaled by horizon; religion_forecast/errors.py),
which covered 89-92% of held-out observations at nominal 90% (horizons 10-40 years, leave one origin out). Both are conditional on WPP 2024 national demography. Each panel has its own scale.
